Follow master `michels-lab/Michel-Software-Standards/docs/AGENT_OPERATING_PROTOCOL.md` for claims, evidence and handoffs.

Start with this repository's `AGENTS.md`, `.michelslab/project.yml`, `MICHELS_LAB_PROJECT.md`, current product log(s) (GIT_AUDIT_LOG.md; android/ANDROID_AUDIT_LOG.md), current code/UX evidence, and canonical `michels-lab/Michel-Software-Standards/standards/PERSPECTIVE_COUNCIL_STANDARD.md`. If master cross-repo access is absent, state it. **Daily/recurring task RPG, chapters/themes, completion history, statistics, daily/premium contracts, Android and paused Windows. Preserve approved Themes/backgrounds and Current Chapter; check real Android task and onboarding journeys.** Do not confuse hypothesized opportunities with shipped or runtime-verified capabilities.

Explore grounded prioritization, adaptive scheduling and actionable progress insights with explainable opt-in rules before using AI; respect private life data and Google auth boundaries. Analyze data quality, security/permission boundaries, offline/error recovery, observability, scalability, platform constraints and transferability to other Michel's Lab products. Compare AI solutions with explicit simpler rules. Every idea needs source data, cost, privacy/consent, failure mode, user override, fallback, measurement and a reason **not** to build it. Never misstate provider/physical/scientific evidence or auto-edit app code.
